requirement.applicantContext: International first-year undergraduate applications in Australia
requirement.subjectNotes: Chemistry HL 4 or SL 5. The English options are grade 5 in SL English A Literature, English A Language and Literature or Literature and Performance; grade 4 in HL English A Literature or English A Language and Literature; grade 6 in SL English B or English ab initio; or grade 5 in HL English B.
requirement.conditions: Complete the IB Diploma and meet the applicable programme and English requirements. Places are limited and the score is indicative. The dedicated Medicine guide specifies a minimum of 39/45. ISAT and a Multiple Mini Interview also apply.
